title: Decision tree and dependency matrix for staged SSO/SAML rollouts and audit-log preservation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a decision tree and a compact dependency matrix that product, security, and infra teams can use to plan a staged SSO/SAML cutover while guaranteeing chain-of-custody for audit logs across customer-pinned regions. Deliverables: an executable decision tree diagram, a dependency matrix mapping services and owners, and a validated light-weight cutover checklist for canary -> ramp -> global phases.
decision_tree: Root: Is the customer in a REGULATED region? -> Yes: require SSO feature-flag + audit-log immutable retention and KMS-sealed keys. No: follow standard staged rollout. Next node: Are downstream services (auth-proxy, sync-worker, metrics-collector) SAML-ready? If any "No" -> either delay rollout for that region or apply temporary proxy shim (proxy-shim owner: infra). If all "Yes" -> schedule canary. Canary outcome: if auth errors <0.1% and log integrity checks pass -> proceed to ramp. If errors >=0.1% or log gaps detected -> rollback and invoke incident playbook.
dependency_matrix_summary: Matrix rows: auth-proxy, user-sync, console-ui, audit-aggregator, log-archiver, kms-keyring, observability-pipeline. Columns: ready-for-saml, must-retain-logs, owner, test-plan-ok, mitigation. Notable constraints: log-archiver retention must be >= 7 years for EU enterprise customers; kms-keyring must have multi-region recovery configured before global ramp. Owners must be assigned before canary schedule is locked.
acceptance_criteria: Decision tree diagram reviewed and approved by Security and Infra leads
Dependency matrix completed with owners and test plans for each service
Canary checklist validated in staging and executed successfully two times without regressions
Automated integrity checks for audit logs enabled and passing in canary region
Rollback playbook validated by on-call and SRE runbook owners
proposed_milestones: M1: Draft decision tree and matrix (owner: PM) - target 2026-01-23
M2: Infra & Security sign-off on mitigation shims - target 2026-02-02
M3: Canary execution in eu-west-1 with audit-integrity observers - 2026-02-15
M4: Ramp to enterprise customers in eu & na regions - 2026-02-28
rollout_checklist: KMS keys provisioned and multi-region recovery validated
Audit-aggregator retention policy set for target region
Observability alerts for auth error spike and missing-log windows configured
Stakeholders notified (CS, Legal, Support) 48h before canary
Backup plan: immediate re-enable of legacy-idp route and hotfix rollback PR template ready
rollback_playbook: Step 1: Pause rollout and flip feature flag to legacy-idp for affected region
Step 2: Trigger automated integrity verification of audit logs to identify missing ranges
Step 3: Engage SRE on-call and Security lead, create incident with severity mapping
Step 4: If missing logs discovered, initiate archival rehydration from log-archiver for the last 72h and notify Legal for customer comms
Step 5: Revert migration PR and schedule a follow-up remediation sprint

notes: This ticket is intentionally focused on planning and de-risking — implementation will spawn ENG tickets per-service. Avoid overloading the matrix; keep it actionable (owners + yes/no readiness + a single mitigation per row).
